notes: ACCESS: robots.txt has no blanket Disallow and does not name Claude/anthropic-ai, so all tiers permitted. Tier (a) curl_cffi (chrome impersonation) fetched raw HTML fine but the site is a client-rendered PWA (Akamai-fronted, Unbxd search-driven) so category item counts are not present in the static HTML - escalated to tier (b) Playwright, which was hard-blocked with an Akamai 403 'Access Denied' on the very first category page load (both default and stealth-args attempts). Per brief rule 4, stopped tier (b) on first block and escalated to tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome, which loaded pages normally (real browser session, no block) and was used for the remainder of the research. TREE: built from union of SiteMap_CAT_00[1-4]_v2.xml (250 category URLs) plus the live mega-menu (DECOR, FURNITURE, OUTDOOR, BEDDING, RUGS & LIGHTING, SEASONAL, HALLOWEEN HAVEN, CLEARANCE) read via Chrome; h1/breadcrumb confirmed on every leaf recorded. QTY: taken verbatim from each category page's 'N Items' header. EXCLUDED: all Bedroom/Dining/Living Room/Home Office/Entryway furniture nav items (Beds, Dressers & Nightstands, Bookcases & Shelves, Cabinets & Sideboards, Benches, etc.) - site explicitly places these under the FURNITURE top-nav, so Furniture per storage.md rule 21/27; New Arrivals, Shop the Look, Shop All/View All pages, Clearance, Under-$100 pages (view-all/promotional per rule 27/35); Lighting (indoor+outdoor); Planters/Urns/Greenery/Wall Decor/Mirrors/Candles/Entertaining & Serveware (decorative accessories, not textile/storage); /outdoor-living/outdoor-rugs/ and /outdoor-living/door-mats/ are duplicate cross-listings of /area-rugs-door-mats/outdoor-area-rugs/ and /area-rugs-door-mats/door-mats/ respectively (identical h1 substance and identical item counts, just linked from two nav paths) - kept once under Rugs & Lighting, dropped the Outdoor-nav duplicates; /outdoor-living/cushions-pillows/ (43 items) is a redundant parent aggregate of the already-recorded 'Outdoor Furniture Cushions' (29) and 'Outdoor Pillows' (26) child categories - dropped per parent-URL rule; /christmas-decor/christmas-storage-maintenance/ 301-redirects to /gifts-celebrations/storage/ (same page, kept once); /bed-and-bath/bedroom-furnishings/ redirects to Beds & Headboards (Furniture, excluded). Site has no dedicated Curtains, Towels, or Bath-linens category at all (checked full sitemap + nav - none exist). 'Baskets' (2 items, indoor-decor/baskets/) is placed under the DECOR nav but the sole product is 'Margot Lidded Baskets, Set of Two' - a genuine lidded storage basket per storage.md section 4 - included in Storage at MEDIUM confidence given the ambiguous nav placement. 'Christmas Pillows & Stockings' (6 items) included in Textile at MEDIUM confidence as genuine fabric stockings/pillows per textile.md section 15.
